simulatedLadderMatches.skipIf: Only provides upload/watch/feed behavior and does not combine playable 3D context plus podcast/source moments.
simulatedLadderMatches.digitalhutEdge: Can turn the watched topic into a research object: video plus GLB plus podcast/source plus market/context plus route proof.
simulatedLadderMatches.trafficPull: Position as alternative daily relax watch interface, not as a direct replacement for creator inventory.

simulatedLadderMatches.skipIf: Only stores or renders 3D assets without tying them to live media topics.
simulatedLadderMatches.digitalhutEdge: Uses GLB as part of a moving media story, not a standalone object page.
simulatedLadderMatches.trafficPull: Target GLB plus video context searches and source-backed 3D proof pages.

simulatedLadderMatches.skipIf: Podcast is only audio/video playback without surrounding 3D/context analytics.
simulatedLadderMatches.digitalhutEdge: Podcast is an interrupt/source moment inside a larger observatory, not a separate episode list.
simulatedLadderMatches.trafficPull: Target podcast source moment for viral video, guest explanation, and research clip language.

simulatedLadderMatches.skipIf: Only curates feeds and does not render topic-specific 3D/podcast/analytics views.
simulatedLadderMatches.digitalhutEdge: DigitalHut is not only discovery; it builds an interactive presentation around the selected topic.
simulatedLadderMatches.trafficPull: Target what-am-I-watching and everyday research observatory clusters.

simulatedLadderMatches.skipIf: Static text explains the topic but does not present media, 3D, and source moments together.
simulatedLadderMatches.digitalhutEdge: Turns topic lookup into a playable research interface.
simulatedLadderMatches.trafficPull: Target wiki lookup visual research hub and source-backed study language.
